canonical_project: Nanping municipal and operator data centers
owner: Nanping municipal government; China Mobile; China Telecom
notes: Fujian Data Management Bureau item says Nanping had a municipal government data-center room of about 900 sq m with 142 standard cabinets, plus two social/commercial data centers: a China Mobile facility of about 8,000 sq m with 300 standard cabinets and a China Telecom facility of about 2,000 sq m with 67 standard cabinets.
